scope: Read-only independent review of scripts/audit-coverage.js, country roster, browser captures, status-report ingestion, lookup/fallback handling and rendered gap visibility. Own Europe report schema was normalized; no tooling, catalog or sibling-module changes made.

checks.result: 250 distinct ISO-country/territory plus Kosovo identifiers are explicit. Geographic scope is not silently reduced to countries with translations.

CLDR functional classifications are qualified, with sourced corrections and explicit unresolved legal scope. Added Europe corrections remove Asturian and distinct Swiss-German written requirements; Azerbaijan Latin law resolves the national az-cyrl misclassification while Dagestan remains separate.

Initially Europe report keys were not consumed by the audit. Normalized to unresolvedMappings and notes; all current country-tag lead groups are now ingested. Verified rendered tag visibility. The initial 11th lead, Montenegrin Cyrillic, was subsequently resolved with an exact cnr-cyrl official profile and translation, leaving 10 unresolved Europe lead groups.

Current scopeReview logic correctly classifies Sweden and Ukraine as scope-review-required despite passing enumerated language cases. Informational Europe clarifications no longer carry statutoryName and therefore do not masquerade as unresolved scope findings.

In-memory merge of pending Europe catalog metadata confirmed Nynorsk resolves to nn, and Dari scenarios preserve a written-form-gap when browser choice yields generic fa. Generic cnr has no CLDR likely-script result; the later exact cnr-cyrl official update supplies the explicit Cyrillic requirement instead of claiming Latin-only coverage.

Linux Chrome, Edge and Firefox captures are labelled as such. Windows profiles and reduced Chrome headers are documented representative/compatibility scenarios rather than claimed observed country defaults. Unsupported menu-choice evidence is distinguished from actual inability to emit a language header.

Oracle models case-insensitive truncation and header order consistently with the documented module. Quality-value and q=0 limitations are explicit rather than claimed fully standards-compliant. No additional blocking fallback error found in the reviewed scenarios.

Language-user estimates, actual self-reported speakers and any-skill figures are distinguished. Non-additivity and unknown counts are explicit; Scots update uses the government-reported 1,508,540 speakers in 2022, not the 2,444,659 people with any skill.

limitations: This is a bounded code/evidence review, not a legal certification that every municipality worldwide has been researched.
Pending catalog integration was simulated in memory for European files without modifying the shared catalog; final reproducibility and nginx replay belong to root's full validation.

Current official scope for UZ Cyrillic Uzbek, RU Cyrillic Azerbaijani, disputed de facto jurisdictions, Scandinavian minority-language administrative rights and omitted Russian regional languages remains explicitly unresolved.
